create_HistoryBuffer: create a HistoryBuffer instance to record log history with a configurable max length
update_HistoryBuffer: update a HistoryBuffer with new log values and their accumulation counts
statistics_HistoryBuffer_mean: compute the mean of the latest window_size values in a HistoryBuffer
statistics_HistoryBuffer_min_max: get the minimum or maximum value within a window of a HistoryBuffer
register_HistoryBuffer_statistics: register a custom statistics method on HistoryBuffer for use via the statistics method
